column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

RE-POINTED AT THE OFFLINE REFEREE.  THE x86_64 STATIC-DECODE LEG drove build/contrib/plugins/isaxcheck, a binary that linked Capstone into the build and was deleted with it, so this row had NO PRODUCER at the tip and read REPORT MISSING -- a red about the apparatus and not about the trace.  Per the standing external-comparison ruling the reference now runs OFFLINE over recorded encodings, and the row is re-pointed at the successor rather than retired: cst_referee.py decodes the recorded encodings offline and gapreport.py joins its opcode word against QEMU's, one bucket per encoding, with every disagreement class arbitrated in gapreport_rulings.tsv. WHAT THIS ONE MEASURES: the same question -- does the trace drop what a reference states, and is every difference understood -- over the encodings the guest actually ran.  The headline is UNRULED encodings (the difference nobody has read) PLUS COVERAGE-PATH encodings (read, and the reference won: the wire owes a change).  Arbitrated-to-QEMU encodings are outside it, exactly as TRACER-SUPERSET was. NO MARGIN: a headline of 4 is a finding to open.  FLOOR 95000 against 105,762 encodings joined with the reference at this tip.  THE STALE FIXTURE IS GONE WITH THE ROW: the selftest default carried 47 against a ceiling of 11 because the banked root predates exec179's re-derivation; the successor report is regenerated at the tip as part of this re-point and the fixture moves with it per #305. exec245 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip).  HEADLINE 57 -> 51 = 35 TRACER-SUBSET + 16 UNACCOUNTED over 1,003 facts / 210 distinct encodings, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 22 AND NOT LOWERED EITHER: the drop is 6 UNACCOUNTED rows retiring to the two comparator rules 7c26bf6144 ported into this leg's sibling, and a ceiling counts rows this project accepts, not the best reading so far.  THE REASON THE ROW STAYS RED IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT APPARATUS: nine of the surviving rows are FINDING 244-C, a REAL TRACER LOSS the ceiling will not cover.  Eight on p_simd -- ld2/ld3/ld4 at 0x4000ec/f0/f4 and add/addv/umov/ins/dup at 0x400124/128/12c/130/134 -- publish ref={REG_VECn...} against trc={}, the wire naming NO destination at all; the ninth is p_hint 0x4000e8 `msr tpidr_el0,x3', ref={REG_TLS} trc={}.  WITNESSED ON THE WIRE, not only in the comparator: cst_decode --format=legacy over p_simd.cst prints `op=GEN_OP_VEC_LOAD src=[] dst=[]' at 0x4000ec and the same empty pair on GEN_OP_VEC_ADD and GEN_OP_VEC_MOV.  IT IS NOT THIS WAVE'S -- the identical eight rows sit in exec242/legs/r13/_work/gem5cp_aarch64/final/rows.tsv -- AND IT IS CONFINED: the neighbouring contiguous ld1 forms at 0x4000dc/e4 and 0x400110/114 DO publish and score REF-NEON-PAIRWISE-DEST, so the gap is the de-interleaving loads and the SIMD ALU/move forms, not NEON as a whole.  The remainder is reference-side and already named: nine dc cvau/civac/cvac rows at 0x4000bc/c0/c4 where gem5 models a cache-maintenance op as a 64-byte data access and QEMU performs none (the leg's own REF-READS-MACHINE-STATE, unapplied here); three dc zva rows at 0x4000cc, SAME-BYTES-DIFFERENT-SPLIT; and one ORTHOGONAL `msr ic_ivau_xt,x21' against a gem5 misc register with no architectural counterpart.  THE WORK THIS ROW NAMES is the p_simd destination gap, and it is a wave of its own.  Prior adjudication, unchanged and still the source of the per-row work: R13_VERDICT.md 4.1

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT (2026-09-18, four arms on ONE build: BASE, after the FR=0 preserve-read fix, after the condition-code write statement, and at the final tree).  HEADLINE 3 -> 1, CEILING HELD AT 1, AND THE CEILING'S OLD BASIS IS SPENT SO RETIRED_BY GOES TO `-'.  The exec244 text's headline of 10 was read before the accumulator landing: at this base 02d2e16c44 the six mult/multu/div/divu/madd/msub rows and their sibling are GONE, because REG_ACCHI0 now has an id of its own, so #282 -- the work item this row named as its retiring condition -- has already done what it could here.  WHAT THIS WAVE MOVED, measured in place: the 2 FPSR-GRANULARITY rows on `c.eq.s' at 0x400148 and `c.lt.s' at 0x40014c, where the reference named REG_FCSR as a destination and the wire named nothing.  It was not a granularity difference at all: the architectural destination of c.cond.fmt is FCC[cc], a field of FCR31, and every cmp helper writes it with SET_FP_COND()/CLEAR_FP_COND() on env->active_fpu.fcr31 from INSIDE the helper, so fpu_fcr31 is never an op's output and the destination reached the wire as nothing.  Stated once for the whole family, in the FOP_CONDS macro after the two operand loads, which is the one place every form passes through; the A/B is on one build and the rows moved exactly with it (BASE 3, preserve-read arm 3, statement arm 1).  THE ONE SURVIVOR, named: `cfc1 r9, f31' at p_fp 0x40013c, reg-dst-value, ref REG_GPR9=0 against trc REG_GPR9=4108.  FIR is a machine-IDENTITY register -- implementation, revision and feature bits -- and the two models describe different machines, so neither value is wrong and there is no datum being dropped.  No work item can retire it: RETIRED_BY is `-' and this is accepted as a property of the reference pair.  NO MARGIN: a headline of 2 is a finding.  43 disagreeing rows total, 42 TRACER-SUPERSET all named, 0 UNACCOUNTED, no axis INERT over 432 facts / 114 subjects.  Prior adjudication superseded in its headline and its RETIRED_BY: the exec244 text (23 -> 10, ceiling 1, #282), whose accumulator half landed.

exec245 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip).  HEADLINE 379 -> 114 over 40,798 facts / 125 encodings, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 0.  THE 265-ROW DROP IS THE APPARATUS DEBT FINDING 244-E NAMED BEING PAID, AND IT IS THIS WAVE'S: 7c26bf6144 ported the two rules this leg's own siblings already carried -- the reference-mapper rule that retires the pure-superset only_trc={REG_PC} class (the identical class the correct-path mipsel leg retired once its rule was written, 165 rows here) and REF-READS-MACHINE-STATE for CPACR_EL1.FPEN on p_wpmem, which gem5 reads as a SOURCE of every FP/SIMD micro-op because it models the FP-enable trap check as an operand read.  An enable gate is not a datum, the leg already named that on 18 p_wpcache rows, and the rule now applies where it always should have.  NO CEILING IS EARNED BY EITHER, WHICH IS WHY 0 STANDS: apparatus debt paid is a comparator that stopped lying, not a disagreement this project accepts.  WHAT IS LEFT, 114, is named and is the row's standing work: 48 on p_wpcache `dc zva' where the reference gives 64 single-byte stores S:0x410540..0x41057f and the wire publishes a different split of the same 64 bytes (SAME-BYTES-DIFFERENT-SPLIT); 36 fpsr-dst-set, 30 only_ref={REG_FCSR} and 6 only_ref={MISC:ic_ivau_xt}, the gem5 misc register the correct-path leg also carries; and the residue of the p_wpmem sys-src family the ported rule does not reach. exec244 RE-DERIVATION (2026-09-18, all 20 rows measured fresh at one tip). HEADLINE 257 -> 105 = 20 WP-DEFECT + 85 UNACCOUNTED over 5,553 facts / 109 encodings, 42 excursions, no axis INERT.  CEILING HELD AT 0.  THE TWO CLASSES THE x87 LANDING MINTED ARE RULED HERE ON WRITTEN MERITS, AND BOTH ARE TRACER-RIGHT.  (A) 60 UNACCOUNTED reg-dst-set rows, twelve x87 PCs (0x40101d..0x401045) x 5 excursions, only_trc={REG_SYS}.  regmap/x86_64.tsv maps fpip/fpcs/fpdp/fpds to REG_SYS with its own written reason -- "x87 exception pointer: machine state saved for a handler, not a value the program computes with" -- and every non-control x87 instruction updates the last-instruction and last-data pointers, so the wire is stating a real destination.  The reference CANNOT speak: this leg's own report prints "unmappable-id:REG_SYS 42", i.e. gem5's x86 vocabulary has no index that produces REG_SYS.  Reference gap with a checkable basis in the mapper, the same shape as the REG_PC class, and the rule is derivable and NOT YET WRITTEN.  (B) 15 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set rows at 0x401025/27/2d x 5, only_trc={REG_FCSR} against ref {REG_FPR0,REG_FPR1}.  Under the composed-register contract settled at 050283a3f1 a folded FIELD publishes its CONTAINER, so reading the rounding-control field of the x87 control word IS a read of REG_FCSR; ledger #277c asks this exact question and answers SOURCE.  Tracer right; the rule is written and not ported to this leg.  (C) THE BRIEF'S ARITHMETIC IS INCOMPLETE AND THE REMAINDER IS NOT SLACK.  60 + 15 = 75, and the headline is 105.  Ten rows at 0x401041 and 0x401043 run the OTHER way: ref={REG_FCSR,REG_FPR0} against trc={REG_FPR0,REG_SYS} -- REG_FCSR is in the reference and NOT on the wire, so two x87 PCs do not publish their status-word write.  That is a LOSS, filed as FINDING 244-D.  (D) 20 WP-DEFECT reg-src-set: 15 on p_wprmw at 0x40104d/0x401062/0x401095 with only_ref={REG_FLAGS}, and 5 on p_wpsse 0x40102b with ref={REG_VEC2} against trc={} -- the x86 sibling of 244-C, a vector source not published at all.  (E) 10 UNACCOUNTED reg-src-set on p_wpchain 0x40102a and p_wpflag 0x401047, only_ref={REG_FLAGS}.  So 75 rows are tracer-right and want rules, and 35 are real losses with two findings against them.  Prior adjudication, unchanged: exec33/flagsleak/EVIDENCE.md -- the leg EXISTS and RUNS; R13_VERDICT.md 5/8.1's "x86_64 has no wrong-path execution reference" is FALSE as written

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT (2026-09-18, three arms on ONE build: BASE, after the FR=0 preserve-read fix, after the store-conditional source statement).  HEADLINE 32 -> 4, CEILING 10 -> 4, and the row's OLD RETIRED_BY list is spent: #269 and #221 named the FR=0 FP-pair class, and THAT CLASS IS NOT WHAT THE HEADLINE WAS.  MEASURED, NOT ARGUED: at BASE the 26 UNACCOUNTED rows on p_wpfp were all strict TRACER-SUPERSET on 13 pcs, every one trc={REG_FPRn, REG_GPR16} against ref={REG_GPR16} -- the DESTINATION of an FP store named as a SOURCE of it.  CAUSE: TCG cannot write part of a global, so gen_store_fpr32/32h/64 lower a narrow FP write as tcg_gen_deposit_i64(fpu_f64[r], fpu_f64[r], ...), and the merge's read of the destination reached the op walk as an ordinary operand read.  R7.1 rules that shape: a narrow write does not acquire a preserve-read source, and under FR=0 the bits carried across are not even architectural (the odd halves of fpu_f64[] are unused there).  FIXED at the four deposit sites with a new anchored primitive, insn_dataflow_note_preserve_read(): the note arms at the op it was taken against and is spent by the write it describes, so an operand load earlier in the same instruction is untouched.  BOTH ENDS ARE LOAD-BEARING AND THE FIRST CUT WAS WRONG: an unanchored version deleted 32 genuine mipsel operand reads where fd equalled fs (`mov.s $f0,$f0'), and the validator's static_reg_sets check caught it -- recorded here because the comment that shipped with that cut asserted the opposite and was FALSE.  THE SECOND FIX, also measured: 2 reg-src-set WP-DEFECT rows on p_wpll 0x400118, `sc $t2, 400($s0)', ref [REG_GPR10, REG_GPR16] against trc [REG_GPR16] -- the stored DATUM missing from the source set.  CAUSE, visible in the source: gen_st_cond() lays both arms of a branchy lowering into one op stream and the FAILURE arm's gen_store_gpr(0, rt) is emitted BEFORE the success arm's gen_load_gpr(val, rt), so a reader walking in emission order meets the write first and charges the read to the instruction's own result.  Stated before either arm exists.  WHAT SURVIVES, ALL FOUR ROWS ONE CLASS: p_flow 0x400138 `jal', reg-dst-valued, x4 excursions, ref REG_LR=0x400140 against trc REG_LR:w=0 -- the wire NAMES the link register and publishes no value for it.  PRE-EXISTING AT BASE and NOT FIXED; witnessed directly on the wire rather than inferred: cst_decode --format=legacy over the wp trace prints `insn[0] dst[0] REG_LR=0x0:w=0' on four wrong-path occurrences of that instruction and `REG_LR=0x400140:w=4' on the correct-path one, with REG_GPR10 and REG_ZERO publishing w=4 in the same excursions -- so the gap is the WRONG PATH's value capture for BRANCH-written destinations, not the register and not the ISA.  FILED AS 245-B.  AND THE CORRECT-PATH LEG IS NOT A WITNESS EITHER WAY: its reg-dst-value axis compares only where both sides state a value, so a width-0 destination is silently not compared there; the cp leg's silence on this pc is an instrument blind spot, recorded so the zero is not over-quoted.  NO MARGIN: a headline of 5 is a finding.  1,703 facts / 80 encodings / 23 excursions, 0 UNACCOUNTED, no axis INERT, 265 TRACER-SUPERSET each carrying a named rule.  Prior adjudication superseded in headline and RETIRED_BY: the exec244 text (154 -> 70, ceiling 10, #269,#221,#266,#282).

exec245 RE-MEASUREMENT AFTER THE THREE DECLARATION GAPS CLOSED (2026-09-18, one tree state, riscv64 binaries unchanged by the later mipsel commit).  HEADLINE 51 -> 4 AND THE CEILING COMES DOWN 5 -> 4, DERIVED FROM A PER-ROW READING AND NOT SET TO THE MEASUREMENT: every surviving row is enumerated below, 0 UNACCOUNTED, 0 adjudication conflicts, 12/12 axes proven live over 2,909 aligned instructions.  FINDING 244-F IS CLOSED AT ITS THREE NAMED QEMU SITES, each fixed where the declaration was missing rather than excused: (1) the 21 csr-src-set QEMU-CSR-FIELD-UNDECLARED rows on REG_FCSR -- fcsr is now ONE declared container spanning CPURISCVState::frm through ::fp_status (riscv_translate_init, offsets from the compiler with a build-time order check), and the rounding-mode read plus the accrued-flag write are stated at gen_set_rm()/gen_set_rm_chkfrm() and at the 27 compare/min/max forms that raise without rounding; csr-src-set now reads ALL AGREE.  (2) the 20 csr-dst-set QEMU-VSTART-HELPER-WRITE rows -- vstart is reset by whichever vector helper ran, so no op carries it; the write is stated in finalize_vset_inst(), the one function every vector form finishes through, and csr-dst-set's 19 remaining rows are now TRACER-SUPERSET reference-gap, not subset.  (3) the 5 QEMU-CSR-ACCESS-OPAQUE rows -- helper_csrr/csrw/csrrw dispatch through csr_ops[] function pointers the reader cannot follow, and the CSR NUMBER is a decode-time constant at the six do_csr* sites, so the access is stated there.  WHAT SURVIVES, ALL FOUR ROWS NAMED: 2 csr-dst-value VALUE-MISMATCH at p_fp 0x10168 and 0x1016c, ref [('fflags', 1)] against trc [('REG_FCSR', 0)] -- the wire now NAMES the destination and publishes NO VALUE for it, because REG_FCSR and REG_VCTRL have no gdb route in riscv64.gdb.tsv and a width-0 field reads as 0.
